story_title: Lina and Adams and the Colour Book
title: Lina and Adams and the Colour Book 🎨 | Learn Colours in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Lina, Adams and Milo make a colour book as a present for Grandma! 🎨🍎🐦
In this English story for kids, children learn 7 new words: colours, red, blue, yellow, green, pink and purple. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
🎨 colours — الألوان — les couleurs
🍎 red — أحمر — rouge
🐦 blue — أزرق — bleu
🍌 yellow — أصفر — jaune
🌿 green — أخضر — vert
🌸 pink — وردي — rose
🦋 purple — بنفسجي / موف — violet

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: play a colour game at home — point to things and ask "What colour is it?" in English. Pause after each new word and say it out loud. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

🇲🇦 قصة باللغة الإنجليزية للأطفال لتعلم أسماء الألوان: أحمر، أزرق، أصفر، أخضر.
🇫🇷 Une histoire en anglais pour enfants pour apprendre les couleurs : rouge, bleu, jaune, vert.

🌙 Subscribe to Moon Tales Kids for a new English story every day!

lines.text: It is a sunny morning. Lina and Adams are in the kitchen.
Adams, Grandma is coming to visit today!
Let's make a present for her. A book full of colours!
Colours are red, blue, yellow, green, and many more.
Everything we see has colours. Say it with me: colours!
Milo the cat jumps up. Meow! He wants to help too.
Lina, Adams and Milo go into the garden.
Look! This apple is red.
And my ball is red too. Red, red, red!
Red is the colour of apples and strawberries.
Can you say it? Red!
Let's draw a red apple in our book.
Next, Lina and Adams walk to the park.
Tweet, tweet! Look at that little bird.
The bird is blue. And the sky is blue too!
Blue is the colour of the sky and the sea.
Say it with me: blue!
I will draw a blue bird. Hello, little bird!
Back in the garden, Milo finds something on the grass.
Meow!
It is a banana! Milo found a yellow banana.
And the sun is yellow. It is warm and bright.
Yellow is the colour of bananas and the sun.
Can you say it? Yellow!
Thank you, Milo. You are a good helper!
Lina and Adams sit down under a big tree.
Look at the grass. The grass is green.
The leaves on the tree are green too!
This carrot has green leaves on top. Crunch, crunch!
Green is the colour of grass and leaves.
Say it with me: green!
Oh no! Where is Adams' blue hat?
Milo has the hat! He is running away with it.
Milo, come back! That is my hat!
Don't worry, Adams. Let's ask him nicely.
Milo, can we have the hat, please?
Milo stops. He brings the hat back. Meow!
Thank you, Milo. You can play with my ball instead.
Lina and Adams smile. Kind words work!
In the garden, there are pretty flowers.
This flower is pink. It is my favourite!
And look, a pink balloon is stuck in the tree.
Adams gently pulls the string. Now Lina has a pink balloon.
Pink is the colour of this flower and this balloon.
Can you say it? Pink!
A butterfly flies near the flowers. Flap, flap!
The butterfly has purple wings!
And look, here is a purple box. We can put Grandma's book in it!
Purple is a colour like grapes and like Lina's dress.
Say it with me: purple!
Purple is a beautiful colour.
Lina and Adams go back to the kitchen.
They draw and draw in the colour book.
A red apple, a blue bird, and a yellow banana.
Green grass, a pink flower, and a purple butterfly!
Milo sits on a chair and watches. Meow!
Our book is finished. It is so colourful!
Grandma will love it.
Ding dong! Grandma is here!
Hello, Grandma! This present is for you.
Grandma opens the purple box. She finds the colour book.
We made it! It has all the colours we found today.
Grandma smiles a big smile. She gives them a warm hug.
Grandma says: thank you, my dears. It is wonderful!
You are welcome, Grandma!
Now Grandma, Lina and Adams drink warm milk together.
Lina, what is your favourite colour?
My favourite colour is purple, like my dress!
My favourite colour is blue, like my shirt!
And Milo? Milo likes his red ball best. Meow!
What is your favourite colour? Say it out loud!
In the afternoon, everyone plays in the park.
They see red, blue, yellow, green, pink and purple everywhere.
Colours make the world so happy!
Let's find more colours tomorrow!
Lina, Adams and Milo run and laugh in the sunshine.
Goodbye, colours! See you tomorrow!
Bye-bye, everyone!
